review.images: Seven native Solis brochure renders show the four towers, landscaped podium, pool, clubhouse and two home interiors. No stock lifestyle scenes are used.
review.location: The original site panel highlights Tower A. Sobha’s Solis community page links the named development pin. Sobha’s separate Motor City community guide supplies the published neighborhood journey estimates.
review.floorPlans: All 22 complete Tower A apartment drawings were visually distinguished from floor keys. Visible variant labels and saleable figures were transcribed directly from the complete sheets.

unavailable: Complete original unit sheets for Towers B–D, project entrance coordinates, current route times, distances and completed-property photographs were unavailable in the reviewed material.
